set.body: Audit PRD A-1 through A-27 against current source, scientific fixtures, supported CI, packaged artifacts, documentation, and release proof. Include complete eyesim baseline coverage, public consumer usability, downstream extension/headless application proof, and versioned persistence failure/migration tests. Missing evidence remains a named release blocker. The foundation acceptance gate precedes publication; final audit also verifies the published artifacts.
set.title: Acceptance criteria audit A-1 through A-27
